author: Sp4rrkii
body:
OK so minecraft has been running fine for a while and it has been running smoothly, until yesterday...
I left Avicus to go to another server for a bit but got bored, so i came back and i get the error message:
java.net.ConnectException: Connection refused: no further information. I thought this was just a problem with avicus but soon all the servers on my list were unreachable for no obvious reason.Can anyone give me some proper help unother than:

Reboot your computer? That doesnt work

Reinstall Minecraft? Nope, not that either

Reboot your WiFi? I dont think any of these quick solutions are gonna help because ive tried them.

Ive also watched loads of youtube videos worth of research but none of them work. Please help ;-;

Turboh
